---
title: "Privify"
subtitle: "A Computer Vision Pipeline for GDPR-Compliant Face Anonymization"
author:
  - name: "Marco Contin"
    affiliation: "Epicode Institute of Technology"
    email: "s00006824@epicode.edu.mt"
date: today
abstract: |
  Privify is a Python-based computer vision pipeline that detects and
  anonymizes faces in video footage to support GDPR compliance for small
  and medium enterprises operating CCTV systems. The system combines a
  fine-tuned YOLOv8n detector (mAP@50 = 0.937 on a single-class face
  dataset) with a configurable Gaussian blur anonymizer. This report
  describes the pipeline architecture, training methodology, empirical
  evaluation, and the domain-shift failure mode observed when deploying
  the in-distribution-optimized detector on street-level CCTV scenes — a
  concrete illustration of the metric-vs-behavior gap in applied ML.
keywords: [computer vision, object detection, YOLOv8, GDPR, anonymization, domain shift, transfer learning]
---
